SFContentBlockerManager.doc: A class that your app uses to interact with a content blocker extension.

SFContentBlockerState.doc: The state of a content blocker extension.

SFSafariApplication.doc: A proxy for the Safari app.

SFSafariExtension.doc: A proxy for the Safari extension.

SFSafariExtensionHandler.doc: A base class that you subclass to handle events in your Safari app extension.

SFSafariExtensionManager.doc: A class that your app uses to find out the current state of a Safari extension.

SFSafariExtensionState.doc: The state of a Safari extension.

SFSafariExtensionViewController.doc: The view controller for a popover associated with your app extension.

SFSafariPage.doc: A proxy for a Safari webpage.

SFSafariPageProperties.doc: An object that captures information about a webpage.

SFSafariTab.doc: A proxy for a tab in a Safari window.

SFSafariToolbarItem.doc: A proxy for a Safari app extension toolbar item in a Safari window.

SFSafariWindow.doc: A proxy for a Safari window.

SFUniversalLink.doc: An object that provides browsers with the ability to discover associations between an app and a website.

SFSafariExtensionHandling.doc: A protocol for implementing event handling in a Safari app extension.

SFErrorCode.doc: Messages that describe a content blocker or Safari app extension error.

SFErrorLoadingInterrupted.doc: There was an error loading the content blocker extension.

SFErrorNoAttachmentFound.doc: The Content Blocker extension returned an NSExtensionItem that did not include an attachment.

SFErrorNoExtensionFound.doc: A Content Blocker or Safari app extension with the specified bundle identifier was not found, or the bundle identifier specified an extension that was not owned by you.

+getStateOfContentBlockerWithIdentifier:.doc: Determines the state of your content blocker.

+reloadContentBlockerWithIdentifier:comp.doc: Tells Safari to reload the specified extension’s content-blocking rules.

+dispatchMessageWithName:toExtensionWith.doc: Sends a message to a Safari app extension, launching Safari if necessary.

+getActiveWindowWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Calls the completion handler with the active browser window.

+openWindowWithURL:completionHandler:.doc: Opens a new window with the desired webpage.

+setToolbarItemsNeedUpdate.doc: Updates the enabled states and badges of toolbar items.

+showPreferencesForExtensionWithIdentifi.doc: Launches Safari and opens the preferences panel for a Safari app extension.

+getStateOfExtensionWithIdentifier:compl.doc: Returns the current state of a Safari web extension.

+getStateOfSafariExtensionWithIdentifier.doc: Returns the current state of a Safari extension.

-dispatchMessageToScriptWithName:userInf.doc: Dispatches a message from the app extension to the content script injected in this page.

-getPagePropertiesWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Retrieves the properties of the webpage.

-reload.doc: Tells Safari to reload the webpage.

-getActivePageWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Calls the completion handler passing the active page in the tab.

-getPagesWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Calls the completion handler with all of the tab’s active and preloading pages.

-setBadgeText:.doc: Sets the badge text for the toolbar item.

-setEnabled:.doc: Sets whether the toolbar item is enabled.

-setEnabled:withBadgeText:.doc: Sets the enabled state and the badge text for the toolbar item.

-setImage:.doc: Sets the image displayed in the toolbar button.

-getActiveTabWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Calls the completion handler with the active tab in the target window.

-getToolbarItemWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Gets the extension’s toolbar item from the target window.

-openTabWithURL:makeActiveIfPossible:com.doc: Opens a tab at the end of the tab bar.

-initWithWebpageURL:.doc: Creates a universal link object with the URL.

enabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the content blocker is enabled.
A Boolean value that indicates whether the extension is enabled.

active.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the page is currently active.

url.doc: Indicates the URL of the page.

usesPrivateBrowsing.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the page is using Safari Private Browsing.

applicationURL.doc: The URL to the app that can open this universal link.

enabled.doc: A flag that indicates whether the universal link is enabled.

webpageURL.doc: The URL specified when initializing the receiver.
